bullets.text: Russian DDoS Attacks Target UK - **NCSC** warns critical infrastructure is under siege from Russian hacktivists.
LilaConnect's Rapid Migration - **LilaConnect** successfully migrated to **gaiia** in just 16 weeks, enhancing customer experience.
AI Chatbots Revolutionize Telecom - AI-powered chatbots are set to transform customer service in the telecom industry.
Blue Origin's 6 Tbps Network - **Blue Origin** announces **TeraWave**, a space network promising 6 Tbps data speeds globally.
Open Cosmos Launches Satellites - **Open Cosmos** activates its first satellites for a new LEO telecom constellation.
AI for Telecom Compliance - **e&** and **IBM** partner to enhance governance and compliance using AI technology.
Wi-Fi 7's 2026 Breakout - **Cisco** predicts 2026 will be pivotal for widespread **Wi-Fi 7** adoption.
Semantic Layers Enhance Telecom Analytics - **Semantic layers** are crucial for scalable analytics in the telecom sector.
Telenor Exits Thailand Market - **Telenor** sells its stake in **True Corporation** for $3.9 billion.
Liberty Global Eyes Three Ireland - **Liberty Global** in talks to acquire **Three Ireland** for €1.5 billion.
